    About

    👋 Welcome on my website.

    I wanted to build a space to share my notes, my ideas, my projects, and I hope you’ll find it useful or interesting.

    • blog posts
    • tutorials

    🔬 Research interests

    I am interested in a lot of research domains, including:

    • Signal Processing and Machine Learning (especially for audio);
    • Combinatorial Optimization and Graph Theory (especially the now popular field of Graph Machine Learning);
    • Links between Cognitive Science and Machine Learning and Biology-inspired Computer Science (Evolutionary ML, Bioinformatics);
    • Ethics and Technology;
    • Natural Language Processing;
    • Deep Learning Theory;
    • Federated Learning;
    • … I am curious and pick interest in many projects.

    Work Experience

    • Facebook AI Research (Jul. - Nov. 2020): Noise-robust ASR.
    • ENS Paris (Apr. - Aug. 2019): Adult/Child directed speech & Voice Activity Detection for Diarization.
    • CentraleSupélec (Oct. 2018 - Mar. 2019): FPT algorithm for vertex/edge min-cut enumeration.
    • Snips (now Sonos) (Jun. - Aug. 2018): Embedded Voice assistant applications.
